newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers said it maintained its buy rating on Brazilian telecom Telebras, but lowered its 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates for the firm.
-- Patrimonio said it lowered its 1996 forecast for Telebras earnings to $2.56 billion from $2.66 billion and its 1997 estimate to $3.73 billion from $4.02 billion.

-- "We are adjusting our earnings estimates for Telebras due to two non-operational issues -- voluntary retirement programs and asset write-offs -- as well as slightly lower-than-expected volume growth," the brokerage said in a report.
-- Telebras is currently trading at a discount to both Latin American peers and a sum-of-its-parts valuation of the company, it added.
-- "Given its relatively attractive valuation, the good telephony growth prospects and evolving regulations, we maintain our buy recommendation on Telebras shares," it added.
-- Telebras's ADR was up 1/2 at 77-7/8 at 1312 local time/1012 EST on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- Its benchmark preferred share was up 0.88 percent at 80.35 reais, while its voting common was up 1.91 percent at 69.50 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
